notes.title: Official Website Live! New Demo Launches in Oct for Steam Next Fest
notes.content: [p]Apologies for the delay! The official website for Zeta Wolf Chronicles is now live! Here you can get acquainted with all 19 characters in the game, check out character profiles, listen to voiceovers, and get to know the ins and outs of everything Chronicles![/p][p][/p][p][url="https://zetawolf.carrd.co/"]Zeta Wolf Chronicles: Official Site[/url][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43774207/21c1124c3acc281f45d61deaa1a87e8741414a91.jpg"][/img][/p][p]There will be a small update to the website in the future that provides screenshots and additional voice previews for the remaining characters. [/p][p][/p][p]A [b]10-hour+[/b] demo will be launched during [b]Steam Fest in October[/b], which will be free for everyone! Please give it a shot, then, and tell me what you think! Thanks for your continued support! [/p]

notes.title: New Key Visual! Website Launching Soon!
notes.content:
Thank you, everyone, for your patience and dedication to our project. I have been working earnestly on this game for the past seven years! Most recently, since Kickstarter funding, I have been regularly updating our backers on our current progress. As we're nearing the release of our revamped and expanded demo, I thought I'd keep everyone abreast of the recent developments.

For starters, we have our recently updated Key Visual art, which will also serve as the game's title screen.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43774207/63bd2d0e3de1818b337587477ae2bc3f65c3e0fe.png[/img]

Secondly, I wanted to announce news of our website that's opening soon! Here are some key points on what to expect: 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43774207/21c1124c3acc281f45d61deaa1a87e8741414a91.jpg[/img]

[list]
[*] Introduction to all 19 characters in the game
[*] Listen to voice previews of all characters
[*] Exploration of key features, lore, and terminology
[*] A plethora of screenshots for you to peruse
[/list]

Here are some more recent developments that I wanted to share with you guys! I managed to take inspiration from the Sprite Viewer from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2771560/Zeta_Wolf_First_Bite]Zeta Wolf First Bite[/url], and I incorporated it into a "Student Handbook" of sorts. This will let you explore each of the characters in the game, at any moment really, accessible from the bottom menu.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43774207/ca3c0f2fb7a6b9ff4ea75b43efb49856593a6579.jpg[/img]

As you go through the game, you'll be able to unlock bio entries, really delving into the more niche characterizations of everyone. The full game will have additional pages and more for each main gal. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43774207/2146c04605e29b876d104f86d6f0bbfcdb727af7.jpg[/img]

I'm happy to reveal that we have finally finished casting for each of our roles, and I'd love to be able to give you guys the chance to meet everyone soon! 


Can we soar past[b] 1000 wishlists[/b]? Once again, I wanted to thank everyone for believing in our project! While the development cycle has been quite lengthy, I want to assure you that we are making great strides toward release! Please mark your calendars for [b]October 13th[/b] for the release of our updated demo on Steam! This will be part of Steam's Next Fest that will run for a week (but the demo will be available continually afterward).

Please continue to follow our developments as we creep ever closer to release!

notes.title: Zeta Wolf: First Bite Available Now!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43774207/fe1853bc2fc02008d183e0e9c472c8e49b56bfcb.jpg[/img]
Thank you for your interest and support for Zeta Wolf Chronicles! I wanted to ensure everyone that ZWC is in actively in development and is set to launch in late 2025. Keep in mind that most updates are backer-only, so updates here will be sparse until we get closer to the launch. 

However, I will tell you guys that I plan to release a public demo for Steam Next Fest in October. This will contain new content not available elsewhere!

In the meantime, why not check out my first released visual novel, Zeta Wolf: First Bite. It is categorized as a "yuri" title, but it's very tame and there's more of a friendship/bonding element going on between the two girls. You'll also be able to glean pieces of backstory that set some plot threads in place for Zeta Wolf Chronicles. 

Currently, it's $5.99 with a 10% discount for the next 10 days!  

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2771560/Zeta_Wolf_First_Bite/
